project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler and Tailwind CSS v4
test_framework: Vitest with React Testing Library (jsdom environment), Playwright for e2e
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify bundle builds successfully. 2. Run npm test to verify all existing tests pass. 3. Run npm run lint to verify linting passes.
environment_constraints: Network access available for npm installs. No Docker daemon needed.
contribution_requirements: All code is .jsx (no TypeScript). Uses flat ESLint config. Vitest config is in vitest.config.js (separate from vite.config.js).
key_patterns: React.lazy for all routes in App.jsx. AppContext provides global state with useCallback-wrapped update functions. useDebounce hook exists at src/hooks/useDebounce.js (callback-style). CommandPalette has its own local useDebounce (value-style). NurseCard is a complex editing overlay - not a pure list item. PlacementCard is a simpler card used in sortable lists. DocumentCard is a local function component inside DocumentRepository.jsx. useMemoizedComputation hook exists for stable memoization.
directory_structure: src/App.jsx (entry with lazy routes), src/context/ (AppContext), src/hooks/ (useDebounce, useMemoizedComputation, useMediaQuery, useOnlineStatus, useAcquisitionCRUD), src/components/ (subdirectories per feature area), src/pages/ (page-level components), src/lib/ (utilities, storage, constants), src/data/ (seed data), src/test/ (test setup and factories)
